evidence: (a) Equivalent search: DESIGN-NOTES.md:17-19 gives stable IDs, current *seat state-path* lookup, and rename notifications; :58 uses ID-addressed mutations, but none defines resolution or rewriting of already recorded output-artifact references. CURRENT-DESIGN.md:8,10,34 likewise supplies identity, moving human-browsable folders, and output references without connecting them. (b) No approved tradeoff accepts stale completed-result references; best-effort missed Herdr observations concerns a different boundary. (c) Narrow scope: this applies to a summary stored under a graph-managed team/seat folder, not an arbitrary external wiki or opaque prose; that placement is contemplated in DESIGN-NOTES.md:229,239, while :256 explicitly makes summary path part of the durable result contract. (d) It matters to the stated ability to recover a responsibility and its evidence after rename (HERDR-GRAPH-VISION.md:33,37,139). After a rename moves the folder, a recorded former path can cease to locate the summary although the result still reports completed coverage. The spec has several possible fixes but selects none. This is an acknowledged draft-design detail, not a claim of actual data loss or implementation readiness.
